set.body:
fmri_lm.formula has 29 formal arguments (fmri_lm.fmri_model 25) and five parallel
vocabularies for configuring the same fit. The precedence between them is
undocumented, contradicts the docs in two places, and is silently wrong in three.

Target: 29 -> 9 formals.

  fmri_lm(formula, block, dataset,
          baseline_model = NULL,
          durations      = 0,
          control        = fmri_lm_control(),  # what is estimated
          compute        = compute_spec(),     # how it is computed
          engine         = NULL,
          ...)                                 # engine_args only

Core idea: formals ARE the schema. Every current defect traces back to configuring
with list() + modifyList, which has no schema, cannot be validated or documented,
and lets two spellings of one field coexist and fight. Replacing the lists with
ordinary constructors (noise_spec, robust_spec, variance_spec, weights_spec,
projection_spec, compute_spec) gets validation, ?help, autocompletion and partial
matching for free, and makes the worst defects unrepresentable rather than fixed.

Evidence base: 191 fmri_lm() call sites surveyed. The options-list route already
beats shorthands 5:1 for AR (61 vs 12); only 17 sites use any shorthand; four
formals have ZERO call sites anywhere.

Design doc: docs/plans/fmri-lm-interface-redesign.md
set.title: EPIC: fmri_lm() interface redesign
